name: NfContext for nf-pi extension
summary: Implement NfContext for the nf-pi extension to handle context management.

rawActions.name: Refactor NfContext to manage EventEmitter, World, and focused task lookup
rawActions.summary: Refactor NfContext (singleton) to bridge World events (e.g., 'change') to its own event bus; NfContext.init() must establish this link to the pre-resolved World and maintain a synchronized 'focusedTask: Task | null' property. Simultaneously, refactor NfOverlay and NfWidget to remove duplicate 'loadFocusedTaskAsAnchor' logic and strip their constructors of the World dependency, delegating all focus tracking to NfContext.

rawActions.name: Refactor index.ts to use NfContext singleton
Refactor NfOverlay to consume NfContext and remove duplicate logic
Refactor NfWidget to consume NfContext and remove duplicate logic

rawReferences.name: world.ts
rawReferences.summary: Defines world state, including focused task
